source_caption:
Hannibal talks about Hindu Lord Shiva -  the destroyer and creator to explain how every new version of a person comes from breaking the old one......But Will sees through it. He asks how many lies, how much conscience Hannibal had to destroy for this “transformation.” And Hannibal’s answer, “As many as were necessary,” shows the truth:  He’s twisting Lord Shiva’s idea of sacred destruction to justify his own darkness. He justifies every cruel act as part of a bigger ‘transformation.

Lord Shiva brings rebirth. Hannibal brings excuses.

Bryan Fuller (Creator of the show) revealed that Mads Mikkelsen & Hugh Dancy often ignored the script’s stage directions and flowed naturally through conversations.
That’s why their pauses, eye contact, and voice changes feel unbelievably real. The actors were basically dueling minds in real time.
